original.target_description: Experiment 2: between-participant short-delay versus 3-day-delay comparison of guessing-adjusted dependence of exemplar on state, with statistics over individual participants' model parameter estimates. Final sample: 15 short-delay and 13 long-delay participants.

n.sample_role: Participants in the mutually exclusive short-delay (15) and long-delay (13) final analytic groups for the Experiment 2 between-delay comparison.
n.exclusions: Two long-delay participants excluded for unsatisfactory size-judgment cover-task performance; 30 recruited, 28 in final analysis.
n.location: 2012 advance proof p. 7, Experiment 2 Results opening paragraph; target comparison on proof p. 8.
n.quote: Two participants were excluded from the long-delay condition ... for failing to perform the size judgment cover task satisfactorily. ... Thus, 15 participants from the short-delay condition and 13 par- ... ticipants from the long-delay condition were entered into the final ... analysis.

es.location: 2012 advance article proof, printed p. 8, Experiment 2, Results, first paragraph; comparison of dependence values with short-delay condition.

p.location: 2012 advance article proof, printed p. 8, Experiment 2, Results, first paragraph; same between-delay comparison as effect size.
